lead.question: 霍克伍德在和平时期用什么办法赚钱，为什么意大利人仍把他视作英雄？
lead.warmup: 歹徒勒索、强收“保护金”看似是现代都市的犯罪，其实早在六百年前就已存在。14世纪，英国雇佣兵头目约翰·霍克伍德爵士带兵来到意大利，在佛罗伦萨附近落脚。他靠向各城邦索要“保护金”大发横财，死后却被佛罗伦萨人以国葬相待，被尊为最勇敢的战士。这究竟是怎样一位“高贵的歹徒”？让我们从课文里寻找答案。
goals: 掌握 gangster、noble、Florentine、prince、band、protection money 等本课核心词汇。
理解并运用 in return for、out of business、make a name for himself 等固定搭配。
复习 would rather...than...、be at war with、in times of peace 等结构以及让步从句。
通过霍克伍德的故事，辨析一般过去时与表过去习惯的 would / used to 的用法。
lead.summary: 课文从芝加哥商人向歹徒缴纳“保护金”说起，指出这种罪恶自古就有。14世纪，英国人约翰·霍克伍德爵士率一队士兵到意大利，在佛罗伦萨附近驻扎并出了名，被意大利人称作乔凡尼·阿库托。战乱时他受雇于出价高的君主；和平时期便带兵闯入城邦，烧毁农场、索取“保护金”后撤离。他借此大发横财，却被视为英雄，死后佛罗伦萨人为他举行国葬并画像纪念。
lead.tips: 注意区分 would rather...than... 与表过去习惯的 would：前者意为“宁愿……而不愿……”，后者描述过去反复发生的动作，如 Hawkwood and his men would march into a city-state。

questions.q: How did Haywood make in times of peace?
questions.zh: 霍克伍德在和平时期是如何赚钱的？
questions.a: In times of peace, when business was bad, he and his men would march into a city-state, burn down a few farms, and offer to go away if 'protection money' was paid to them.
questions.aZh: 和平时期生意萧条时，霍克伍德便带领士兵进入某个城邦，纵火烧毁一两个农场，然后提出：只要缴纳“保护金”，他们就主动撤离。
questions.hint: 答案见课文第八句：“In times of peace, when business was bad, Hawkwood and his men would march into a city-state...”

questions.q: What did the gangsters do if the money was not paid promptly in Chicago?
questions.zh: 在芝加哥，如果钱款没有及时缴纳，歹徒会怎么做？
questions.a: They would quickly put a man out of business by destroying his shop.
questions.aZh: 他们会很快捣毁他的商店，使他破产。
questions.hint: 见课文第二句，注意 put a man out of business 的含义。

questions.q: What did Sir John Hawkwood discover in the fourteenth century?
questions.zh: 14世纪，约翰·霍克伍德爵士发现了什么？
questions.a: That people would rather pay large sums of money than have their life work destroyed by gangsters.
questions.aZh: 人们情愿拿出大笔的钱，也不愿毕生的心血毁于歹徒之手。
questions.hint: 见课文第四句，由 made the remarkable discovery that... 引导的宾语从句。

questions.q: How did the Florentines honour Hawkwood when he died at the age of eighty?
questions.zh: 霍克伍德80岁去世时，佛罗伦萨人是如何纪念他的？
questions.a: They gave him a state funeral and had a picture dedicated to his memory.
questions.aZh: 他们为他举行了国葬，并为他画像以示纪念。
questions.hint: 见课文最后一句，gave him a state funeral 与 had a picture dedicated to his memory。

questions.q: Why did the Italians regard such a man as a sort of hero?
questions.zh: 为什么意大利人会把这样一个勒索钱财的人视为某种英雄？
questions.a: Although he made money by threatening the city-states, he was a skilled soldier who could protect a city at war, so the Italians respected his courage and leadership.
questions.aZh: 尽管他靠威胁城邦来敛财，但他毕竟是能保护交战城邦的出色军人，意大利人敬重他的勇武与领袖才能，因此把他当作英雄。
questions.hint: 结合课文 In spite of this, the Italians regarded him as a sort of hero 以及结尾的赞语思考。

exercises.q: 汉译英：榨取“保护金”并不是一种现代的罪恶行径。
exercises.a: Obtaining 'protection money' is not a modern crime.

exercises.q: 填空：There was a time ___ the owners of shops in Chicago had to pay large sums of money to gangsters ___ return for 'protection'.
句型转换：Hawkwood and his men would march into a city-state.（用 used to 改写，意思不变）
exercises.a: Hawkwood and his men used to march into a city-state.
exercises.note: would 与 used to 表过去习惯。

exercises.q: 改错：In spite of this, the Italians regarded him like a sort of hero.
exercises.a: In spite of this, the Italians regarded him as a sort of hero.

exercises.q: 汉译英：尽管霍克伍德靠这种方式赚了大钱，意大利人还是把他当作英雄。
exercises.a: Although Hawkwood made large sums of money in this way, the Italians regarded him as a sort of hero.

exercises.q: 用定语从句合并：Hawkwood used to hire his soldiers to princes. + The princes were willing to pay the high price he demanded.
exercises.a: Hawkwood used to hire his soldiers to princes who were willing to pay the high price he demanded.
exercises.note: who 引导定语从句修饰 princes。

exercises.q: 汉译英：如果交款不及时，歹徒们就会很快捣毁他的商店。
exercises.a: If the money was not paid promptly, the gangsters would quickly put a man out of business by destroying his shop.
exercises.note: 过去将来时加 out of business。

quiz.q: 在芝加哥，店主和商行的老板们不得不做什么？
options: Give up their shops to the police.
Pay large sums of money to gangsters.
Hire soldiers to protect their shops.

quiz.q: 根据课文，霍克伍德爵士率士兵到意大利后在哪里驻扎下来？
和平时期，霍克伍德和他的士兵做了什么？
options: They hired themselves out to princes.
They marched into a city-state and burned down a few farms.
They gave the Italians a state funeral.
They paid large sums to the gangsters.

quiz.q: “made a name for himself” 在文中的意思是？
意大利人如何看待霍克伍德？
quiz.note: In spite of this 含让步意味。

quiz.q: 根据课文，“protection money” 指什么？
options: Money paid by the government to soldiers
Money paid to gangsters to avoid being destroyed
Money spent on guarding a city
